Otherwise the cell stays as written. Pumping Pressure is 40 MPa.

body.en: An electric motor cell is kilowatts on a motor. It does not change this power cell, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. question.en: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the cell stays as written.

question.en: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
